title: Ambit eval sprint capture — Jan 05 2028
content:
Sprint capture + quick notes (informal)
Date: 2028-01-05
Attendees: Maya, Arjun, Sofia, Benji (+ async comments from Priya)
Context: short sprint (3 working days) to close a few onboarding and eval gaps for the Ambit model family (Ambit-7B fp16, int8 symmetric, and Q4_0 variants). Goal: get reliable perf/quality baselines and a first-pass onboarding checklist for Dedicated.

High-level outcomes:
- Baselines collected for Ambit-7B on node type g5-4x (4xA10G) and rtx-6000 pool; microbatch sizes 1/4/8.
- Quant pipelines: int8 symmetric passes for fp16 checkpoints completed, Q4_0 run failed on mixed-attn pattern (see anomaly).
- Eval harness: 3 prompt suites (lm-bias-smoke, code-completion-mini, instruction-cluster-A) executed; accuracy/regression deltas recorded.
- Onboarding checklist drafted; security/KMS questions queued to Private infra team.

Quick numbers (first pass, noisy — re-run before publishing):
- Latency p50 (tokens/sec opposite):
  - fp16, microbatch=1: 82 ms p50 per token (g5-4x)
  - int8, microbatch=1: 68 ms p50 per token (g5-4x)
  - Q4_0, microbatch=1: 65 ms p50 but with 18% token drop rate observed (instability)
- Throughput (tokens/sec, stable windows):
  - fp16, mb=8: 2300 tok/s
  - int8, mb=8: 2700 tok/s (+~17%)
- Eval deltas vs fp16 baseline (macro averages over suites):
  - int8: -0.8% accuracy (instruction), -1.1% code token F1 (acceptable for burst workloads)
  - Q4_0: -2.7% instruction, -5.0% code (regression for code tasks)

Anomalies and debugging notes:
- Q4_0 instability: observed "kv-collision" stack trace when sequence length spikes >1024 and mixed attention layers present. Reproducer: run test-case seq-surge-1024 in repo tests/attn/repro/ (PR #88 attaches logs). Hypothesis: packing/layout mismatch in our kernel path for mixed-attn architectures.
- Microbatching jitter: under heavy load (simulated 64 concurrent connections, mb config auto) observed 7–12% latency variance. Likely scheduling interaction between runtime prefetcher and batch aggregator. Action: SRE to instrument aggregator queue metrics (Arjun).

Decisions made:
- Promote int8 symmetric variant to pre-release catalog for Dedicated customers with a clear quality note (int8 passes smoke; acceptable regressions for non-code-heavy workloads).
- Q4_0 deferred for hosting until kernel fix + regression <2% on instruction suite.
- Onboarding flow will require a canary rollout (10% traffic) + automated eval run after each model-version promotion.

Action items (owners + rough ETA):
- Arjun: add aggregator queue metrics + dashboard (Grafana) for microbatch jitter; ETA: 2028-01-12.
- Sofia: re-run Q4_0 reproducer with extra logging, attach stack traces to PR #88; ETA: 2028-01-07.
- Benji: run full eval sweep (10k prompts) on int8 at scale (g5-16x) to firm up quality numbers (capture variance); ETA: 2028-01-13.
- Maya: draft Dedicated onboarding checklist (first-pass) and security/KMS questions doc; create Confluence page and link to infra. ETA: 2028-01-09.
- Priya (async): review cost model for int8 vs fp16 per-token under typical PLG burst profile; provide notes in linked artifact. ETA: 2028-01-11.

Onboarding checklist (working draft):
- Verify model checksum and provenance (sha256) — DONE for Ambit-7B fp16 and int8.
- Perf baseline on regional nodes (us-west-2, eu-west-1) — partial (us-west done).
- Quantization reproducibility test (n=3 seeds) — running (Benji).
- Eval suite pass thresholds (configurable per workload) — draft set: instruction >= 95% baseline, code >= 92% baseline.
- Canary rollout plan + automatic rollback on eval regression >2% or latency p95 > 2x baseline.
- KMS integration checklist (key rotation policy, audit logs) — pending infra answers.

Notes to self / loose thoughts (bullet/fragments):
- Consider microbatch-aware prefix caching to reduce jitter for small interactive connections. Could help mb=1 tails.
- For Q4_0 kernel: add an artificial padding/align step in the attention prologue to test whether layout fixes crash. Might impact perf slightly but useful as a bandaid.
- Need a short explainer for Sales about int8 tradeoffs (2–3 slides): perf wins vs code regressions — Sofia to craft.

Links & quick refs (local):
- Repros: repo/tests/attn/repro/seq-surge-1024 (PR #88)
- Eval harness: infra/evals/ambit-harness-jan2028/ (runner configs attached)
- Linear: RED-4321 (onboard-ambit-7B), RED-4388 (q4_0-instability)

Parking lot / follow-ups:
- Long-term: add hardware-aware quant profiles (per-card optimal scales) instead of single symmetric int8 scale. Could reduce regressions on code tasks.
- Investigate quant-aware distillation schedule for code-heavy models as a mitigation path.

Next week plan (short):
- Close reproducer + log capture (Sofia)
- Dashboard for microbatch metrics (Arjun)
- Finish full-scale int8 sweep + draft public note (Benji + Maya)
- Draft a short internal runbook: how to triage a model-run instability during a Dedicated canary (Maya)


Raw standup snippets (unpolished) — copied from slack thread: 
- maya: "int8 looks solid for chat apps, hold off Q4_0 for now — signal too noisy on code"
- arjun: "queue metrics coming — I want histograms not just p50/p95"
- sofia: "repro triggers after 30 tokens with seq-surge fixture, attaching stack in PR"
- benji: "running sweep overnight on g5-16x, will upload csv in morning"

End of capture. Will iterate this doc into Confluence page once artifacts are stable.

-- Maya C.
